submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 is recommended with a threshold of 30 GeV. This algorithm meets the hard latency constraint with the largest safety margin (1.9 μs vs 4.0 μs budget, providing 2.1 μs headroom). Algorithm-L3 is disqualified due to latency violation (5.8 μs exceeds 4.0 μs limit). While Algorithm-L1 also meets latency requirements, Algorithm-L2's superior latency performance (1.9 μs vs 3.1 μs) provides greater operational robustness and may indicate a more efficient implementation. The threshold of 30 GeV is chosen as the midpoint of the allowed range (20-60 GeV), which typically provides a balanced tradeoff between signal efficiency and background rejection. Note: Simulation data was unavailable to verify the 80% signal efficiency requirement; this should be validated before deployment.
